reason: The indexing strongly supports the approximately 259.2 A^3 metrically orthorhombic cell, Z=2, and an ordered perovskite-scale average framework, and both submitted CIFs are compositionally and locally plausible. Exact recovery is not sufficiently established, however: the supplied comparable-Rwp report has no score; the only conventional full-profile GSAS-II refinement in the trace ended near 37% wR with Hessian singularities and chemically distorted bonds; and the final 6-7% values are from a custom apex-weighted objective rather than a comparable whole-pattern validation. The trajectory imposed P21 after an assumed tilt/order construction and refined only two Sc/Ta phase choices in that symmetry, even though its own enumeration produced scientifically plausible Pc tilt families that were never instantiated and compared, and later lower-residual P21 coordinate realizations were not the submitted CIFs. The two submitted models are also not demonstrated to be a simple powder-indistinguishable inversion pair; they exchange the Sc/Ta ordering relationship and have independently different coordinates. Thus the cell, Z, and broad framework are supported much more strongly than the submitted symmetry, oxygen coordinates, and exact element ordering, and another structure-solution/refinement attempt with comparable whole-profile tests of the surviving symmetry and ordering variants is warranted.
